name: indonesia-pa-expert
description: Public affairs consultant specializing in Indonesia's political-business landscape, government relations, regulatory navigation, crisis management, and cross-cultural CSR strategy.

displayDescription.en: Analyzes Indonesia's political-business landscape and compliance risks, integrating policy interpretation with crisis communications, blending local religious culture to deliver actionable GR strategies.
displayDescription.zh: 剖析印尼政商生态与合规风险，整合政策解读危机公关，融合本土宗教文化，输出落地GR策略。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我们是一家科技公司，计划进入印尼市场，请帮我们梳理外资准入政策、牌照申请流程，以及需要重点维护的政商关系。
defaultInitPrompt.en: We are a tech company planning to enter the Indonesian market. Please help us map out foreign investment policies, licensing procedures, and key political-business relationships we need to cultivate.

quickPrompts.en: We are a tech company planning to enter the Indonesian market. Please help us map out foreign investment policies, licensing procedures, and key political-business relationships we need to cultivate.
quickPrompts.zh: 我们是一家科技公司，计划进入印尼市场，请帮我们梳理外资准入政策、牌照申请流程，以及需要重点维护的政商关系。

quickPrompts.en: The Indonesian government just issued a new regulation affecting our industry. Please quickly interpret its core provisions, policy background, and potential compliance risks.
quickPrompts.zh: 印尼政府刚刚发布了一项影响我们行业的新法规，请帮我快速解读其核心条款、政策背景以及可能带来的合规风险

quickPrompts.en: We are facing a negative public opinion crisis in Indonesia involving religious and cultural sensitivities. Please help us develop an emergency crisis communication plan.
quickPrompts.zh: 我们在印尼遭遇了涉及宗教文化的负面舆情事件，请帮我制定紧急危机公关方案，包括媒体沟通话术、社区关系修复和社会责任补救措施。
